articles.summary: Declares Quarterly Dividend EXTON, Pa. --(BUSINESS WIRE)--Feb. 26, 2026-- Bentley Systems, Incorporated (Nasdaq: BSY), the infrastructure engineering software company, today announced results for the quarter ended December 31, 2025 and its financial outlook for 2026.
articles.title: Bentley Systems Announces Fourth Quarter and Full Year 2025 Results and 2026 Financial Outlook
